zh.title: 发布状态
items: **0.1.0-rc.20** 修复大历史项目后台恢复检查造成的全局间歇停顿。正式版仍为 0.0.18。

zh.title: 修复与优化
items: 恢复检查按工作读取，一批事件共享当前任务观察，一次选取只做一次恢复准备，避免历史工作与事件相互放大。
输入归属改为批量读取；计划调度在没有异步等待和写入的同步阶段复用观察，状态变化后重新读取。
续接发现使用带文件版本校验的最小检查点投影；实际续跑和合并仍读取完整原文，保留取消、未知执行和租约限制。
常规聊天页不再反复传输内部执行轮次；打开回复详情时按消息身份读取完整过程，保留历史错误、派发和排队标记。
任务观察先过滤所属项目再加载完整计划；输入队列复用已校验的历史图片，文件或严格读取要求变化时重新校验。
补足大历史验收的历史工作和送达回执分布，检查输入、滚动的 P99 与单次峰值。

zh.title: 升级与验收范围
items: 沿用 RC19 数据格式和权限链；升级前备份完整数据根，Desktop、CLI/TUI 与 Gateway 同步升级。正式版通道不变。
实际历史仅用于无凭据的本地隔离复现；真实模型任务使用合成历史，不发送用户私有历史。
性能结果不代表零延迟峰值；产品截图为实施者自审，完整读屏、Windows/Linux 交互安装和长期日用不在本轮断言内。

en.title: Release status
items: **0.1.0-rc.20** fixes intermittent application-wide stalls caused by background recovery scans with large project histories. Stable remains 0.0.18.

en.title: Fixes and improvements
items: Read recovery work individually, share current task observations within an event batch, and prepare recovery once per selection to avoid historical work/event amplification.
Read pending input ownership in one batch. Reuse plan observations within synchronous scheduling phases with no writes or awaits; re-read after changes.
Use bounded, file-version-checked checkpoint facts for continuation discovery. Actual continuation and merging retain full original checkpoints, cancellation, unknown-outcome and lease guards.
Keep internal execution rounds out of refreshing chat pages. Load complete reply processes by message identity on demand, preserving historical diagnostics and dispatch/queue badges.
Filter project ownership before hydrating watch plans. Reuse validated historical image inputs until their file version or strict-read requirements change.
Extend large-history acceptance with historical works and delivered receipts, and check P99 and worst-case input/scroll latency.

en.title: Upgrade and validation scope
items: Retain RC19 data formats and permission boundaries. Back up the complete data root and upgrade Desktop, CLI/TUI and Gateway together. The stable channel is unchanged.
Personal history is used only in local credential-free isolated reproduction. Real-model tasks use synthetic history without uploading personal records.

Performance results do not imply zero latency spikes. Screenshot review is implementer self-review. Full screen-reader coverage, interactive Windows/Linux installation and long-term use remain outside this claim.
